set.body: Native provider work for PLS Neuro C5 bd-01M236KQ69JKD3CPE0ZNPW0M45. Add a general typed transaction that replaces a declared compatible group of scalar and packed-RGBA surface layers while structurally sharing assets and presentation state. Validate duplicate and unknown IDs, layer kind, surface ID, ordered mesh domain, vertex/face association, interpolation, frame compatibility, sample count and ownership. Separate preparation from JavaFX apply; preserve current camera, viewpoint and selection. Declared validation, capability and budget rejection must leave both hemispheres, picking, controller state and metadata at the previous generation, including a second-hemisphere failure followed by recovery. Receipts distinguish rendered layer changes, no-op or hidden updates, stable warm updates without geometry uploads, and first atlas refinement. Shared JVM and JS tests plus native JavaFX evidence are required; base consumer adoption on admitted revision 535977a86270bd3cc5c033eda165a0370870dd22.
set.title: Atomically replace compatible surface-view layer groups
